text_en: Monday (July 27) New York afternoon trading: The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note fell 3.65 basis points to 4.6406%, remaining in a downtrend throughout the day, refreshing its daily low at 08:15 Beijing time to 4.6244% and rebounding to 4.6629% at 22:00. The 2-year US Treasury yield fell 1.05 basis points to 4.3201%, refreshing its daily high at 14:57 and 22:00 to 4.3306%; the 30-year US Treasury yield fell 3.35 basis points to 5.1239%. The 2/10-year US Treasury yield spread narrowed 2.187 basis points to +32.045 basis points.
